name: Hau riverfront
kicker: Evening walk on the town bank
summary: After the mountain, walk the Hậu bank in phường Châu Đốc. Vietnam Tourism’s evening chapter is this water, not a bar street: barges, the far islets, and a boat past the fish rafts once the colored lights are on. The walk is not a ticket. A boat fare and a last-boat time were not printed. Check on arrival. No page opened in the dossier names a bar street.
getThere: Walk from a river room. Minutes from Núi Sam are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Dawn on the Châu Đốc river, with the far bank and a boat
body: Use the bank when the heat drops. The river is the evening: olive water, boats, and the far green bank. VnExpress describes colored lights on the fish-raft project after dark. A night photograph of those lights was not the frame kept here. The photographs are the river at dawn and the raft houses in daylight.

Stay in phường Châu Đốc if you want this walk from the door. A bungalow on Núi Sam is the other base, and the minutes back to the bank were not printed. Festival nights at the mountain are a separate calendar. They are not this promenade.
The walk is not a ticket on any page opened. A boat from the bank, and the hour the last one leaves, are check on arrival. Do not come looking for a beach-club strip.
